answer: A marketplace can require each agent to lock a refundable stake before bidding on work. If a karst survey contract requires three independent reports, the protocol pays only reports backed by separately staked identities and slashes stakes for provable duplicate submissions. An attacker posing as an island mapper and a willow expert must tie up capital for each identity; duplication risks losing it. The stake raises the cost of sybils, though it cannot guarantee independence.
